# Daily Briefing – Thursday 30 July

Yesterday was a quiet one — no training, just 4,257 steps and a burn of 2,310 kcal, which almost perfectly matched your 2,300 target. That's solid discipline on a rest day. The main concern is sleep: 5.5 hours simply isn't enough to drive the recovery and body composition progress you're chasing.

The good news is your other markers look strong. HRV at 98ms sits just below your 101–118ms baseline, and a resting HR of 49bpm with stress at 25/100 suggests your body is calm and ready. Don't let the slightly dipped HRV spook you — go ahead with today's planned session as normal.

Tonight, prioritise sleep above everything else. Aim for 8 hours — it's your most powerful fat-loss and recovery tool right now, more impactful than any supplement. Set a firm lights-out alarm and protect it.
